title: "Business on WhatsApp is tough now—but am I really a businesswoman?" Exploring Challenges with Adapting to Changes in WhatsApp Business
reasoning: The paper is a qualitative human-computer interaction (HCI) study focused on the adaptation of small business owners to changes in the WhatsApp Business platform. While it explores themes of power imbalances and digital colonialism, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
